description: Thresholds for the Arkham entity-aware wallet gate

prohibited_tags.description: Arkham behavioural tags that deny outright regardless of amount or attribution (e.g. 'sanctioned', 'hacker', 'scam', 'mixer'). Matched case-sensitively against the normalised tags the oracle emits.

approved_entity_categories.description: Arkham entity categories that qualify for the full verified tier (e.g. 'cex', 'custodian', 'defi'). An attributed address outside this set is capped at tier_unlabelled_max_usd.

tier_verified_max_usd.description: Hard ceiling in USD for any single transaction, applied even to a verified, approved-category destination.

tier_unlabelled_max_usd.description: Introductory cap in USD for destinations Arkham cannot attribute, and for attributed destinations outside approved_entity_categories.

min_attribution_confidence.description: Minimum Arkham attribution confidence (0-1) required to act on an entity match. A lower-confidence match denies, so a human can approve it out of band.

deny_on_no_attribution.description: When true, an address Arkham has no attribution for denies outright rather than falling back to tier_unlabelled_max_usd.

max_risk_score.description: Maximum tolerated Arkham headline risk score (0-100) for the destination.

max_data_age_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated age of the Arkham observation. Null ages from the oracle fail-soft and do not trigger this rule.
